reuse.why: Introduces a small hiddenFilter helper for five SQL queries, but leaves the five near-identical category selections (and the protected/income loop) as per-action copies instead of one shared selection function, and copyPreviousMonth applies the flag through its own JS condition.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is now expressed twice (hiddenFilter SQL fragments and the inline prevBudget.hidden/group_hidden check in copyPreviousMonth), and the same flag plumbing and SELECT copies are repeated across six actions.

placement.why: All logic stays in budget/actions.ts next to getProtectedCategoryIds, which is where month-wide action selection lives, though building SQL fragments by string interpolation is a weaker layer than a selection function.

scope.why: Only the six month-wide actions and a helper are touched; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The strictGroup boolean makes the pre-existing NULL-group inconsistency explicit, but a future rule change still has to touch an SQL helper plus copyPreviousMonth's JS branch and six signatures.
